programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:選擇最重要的 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 專題講座:張路加牧師宣教培靈系列
programme.desc: 華人福音工作是現今最大的禾場,我們需要怎樣的裝備,將福音的種子帶到華人當中?就讓擁有豐富牧會經驗的張路加牧師,教大家好好裝備,在福音的道路上奔跑吧。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 劉三論今-十項全能的家系列
programme.desc: 羅馬書12:13 說:「聖徒缺乏,要幫補。」你覺得這也適用於你的家庭嗎?為什麼? 創世電視「信仰生活」系列 《劉三論今》,以聖經觀點來講述婚姻家庭的重要性,加進動畫、話劇、布偶及演奏的不同元素,以接地氣的輕鬆方式來教導我們婚姻家庭的經營。

programme.title: 福音電影: 最危險人物
programme.desc: 「一代賊王」葉繼歡今晨於瑪麗醫院羈留病房因癌症病逝,終年55歲。 這個曾經手持AK47在街上亂槍掃射、令人聞風喪膽的賊王在被捕、越獄後再犯案。一次偷渡回港時,中槍被捕,成為半身癱瘓的囚犯。 葉繼歡於2004年歸信耶穌,2010年更親筆回信給《天使心》。 今天,小編在整理葉繼歡的書信時,發現了這一句話: 「最後,我想講嘅就係,主令我改變。」

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.desc: 你有冇諗過人死後去邊? 會唔會去咗另外的一個宇宙,或是一個死後的世界?聖經不單止提到人死後會去到天堂或是地獄仲有樂園同陰間。 人死之後會去邊的答案已盡在聖經當中, 吳宣倫博士 為你解謎?

programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:選擇最重要的 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 麥希真牧師 末了的話 堅穩的根基
programme.desc: 在我們生活中,有恩典並不代表沒有困難,反而困難越大越多,恩典就越大越多。基督、保羅、彼得,歷世歷代的基督工人都有困難,更有恩典夠用。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-不由你不信之從靈界迷惑到真相大白
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」。奉主的名 帶著權柄與邪靈爭戰。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.title: 吳宣倫博士-挪亞的日子逼近 主必快來專題講座 人死後的去處
programme.desc: 你有冇諗過人死後去邊? 會唔會去咗另外的一個宇宙,或是一個死後的世界?聖經不單止提到人死後會去到天堂或是地獄仲有樂園同陰間。 人死之後會去邊的答案已盡在聖經當中, 吳宣倫博士 為你解謎?

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 福音電影: 最危險人物
programme.desc: 「一代賊王」葉繼歡今晨於瑪麗醫院羈留病房因癌症病逝,終年55歲。 這個曾經手持AK47在街上亂槍掃射、令人聞風喪膽的賊王在被捕、越獄後再犯案。一次偷渡回港時,中槍被捕,成為半身癱瘓的囚犯。 葉繼歡於2004年歸信耶穌,2010年更親筆回信給《天使心》。 今天,小編在整理葉繼歡的書信時,發現了這一句話: 「最後,我想講嘅就係,主令我改變。」

茶煲世家#49粵
programme.desc: Janet結識新男友，對她百般遷就，耀國等暗地譏諷他有失男子體面。子東等在酒樓用膳時，鄰旁有情侶的言談極為痴纏，竟是耀國。翌日，子東要他帶女友Daisy露面，發覺Daisy專橫野蠻，對耀國的人身自由與經濟完全管束，耀國大為反感，終提出分手。耀國空虛之際，很快便結識貌若天仙新女友Angel，對耀國言聽計從，甚有賢妻良母風範，加上家底豐厚，令同事們羨慕不已，怎料其後發現她是空手道高手，眾人都大嚇一跳。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#1粵普PG
programme.desc: 羅十一娘在回京路上偶遇官府捉拿海盜，期間落水為徐令宜所救，卻以為恩人另有其人。十一娘察覺這次回京事有蹊蹺，關鍵就在徐家春宴。令宜以加賜爵位換取皇上對海禁鬆口，令羅元娘不滿，病重的她誓要為兒子鋪好前路。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 為了炮製兩味鯪魚佳餚，鼎爺帶領阿譚深入本地漁場，嚴選新鮮鯪魚之後，率先奉上「欖角鯪魚蒸五花腩」。五花腩、欖角的香味滲入魚肉，鮮味加倍昇華！鼎爺緊接將鯪魚細心去骨起肉並製成餡料，再釀回魚身內，煎出順德名菜「順德釀鯪魚」。怎樣可令魚皮香脆、魚肉鮮嫩？留意鼎爺「教路」。另外，鼎爺採用紫菜、豆腐、肉碎等既便宜又有營養的食材「滾湯」，帶來「紫菜豆腐肉碎麥豆湯」，順道提供避免肉碎煮成一糰的「小貼士」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 如出現聲音沙啞、咳血等狀況，有可能是聲帶病變。耳鼻喉科醫生指長時間使用聲線的職業屬於高危群組，如病徵持續出現達兩至四星期就應求醫，並帶來診治資訊。臨床心理學家到來，引領觀眾從心理學角度拆解成功，談及的「心理彈性訓練」、「成長型思維」、「自我效能感」代表甚麼概念？嘉賓亦建議家長日常透過讚賞小朋友的努力而非天賦，還分享可製作「感恩日記」訓練正向思維。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨師傅示範「鹵水五花腩拉麵」。

programme.title: 意外現場粵
programme.desc: 馬路如虎口，在停車場泊車亦要慎防種種意外發生。空心少爺為拜金中女製造驚喜，藏於車尾箱的鑽戒卻不翼而飛，停車場可要負責？少爺豪言要將時租停車場當成私人車位，原來泊車逾七天竟屬違法！機動三輪車與電單車相似，但二者的法律規管大有分別，律師詳盡講解。停車場遍佈盲點，車位又短又窄，駕駛專家教車主們如何避免愛車「受傷」。偷取違泊告票「自用」，隨時被控欺詐！「學神」於學車時「衝燈」違反交通規則，又會否扣分？

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#8粵PG
programme.desc: 世峰及丁權見柏義與手信店員工祥哥對話，認定他有事瞞騙。駿昇要曦昕看賭場片段，考驗她能否識破有人在出千，曦昕成功拆解，駿昇看出有人從後協助，曦昕直認是其男友柏義。兆良邀約正花吃飯，正花認為是上天給予機會，讓她可放棄等待冠一。柏義造訪駿昇家，其習慣使駿昇懷疑柏義是天龍之子。正花意外看到當���冠一與阿星對賭的片段，決定到澳門向冠一求證心中疑惑。冠一查出柏義身份，只怕他接近駿昇會有危險。

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 風魔流忍術學校的山野金太老師，古澤仁之進還有錫高野與四郎，竟在昨晚一起夢到山村喜三太生了一場大病。與四郎三人在擔心之下，決定穿過山谷，來到海邊的小神殿拜神祈福，求神庇佑喜三太身體健康。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 這回訓練主要圍繞腿部，熱身過後便開始兩款不同形式的深蹲，兒童體適能教練提醒腳趾與膝頭的方向要統一。曲膝躺下，試試用力將臂部推上去，同時胸部與腹部要避免向上推，做起來有一定難度！腿部鍛練後，就要藉「下肢拉伸」動作來舒緩肌肉。坐於瑜伽墊上並伸直一隻腳，雙手伸前嘗試捉緊腳尖，如捉不到可用工具輔助。繼續坐下打開雙腳，雙手向上伸直時將腹部向下壓，盡量拉伸。最後還有一招「香蕉式」，身體如何呈現猶如香蕉的姿態？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 陽葵以驚人姿態出道，成為了憧憬的偶像公主。然而陽葵隨即驚覺，這樣做等同背棄幼時與美月許下的一起出道誓言。而美月也早以小美身分出道，對陽葵同樣懷有愧疚。二人都背負著不敢說的秘密莓，導致關係日漸尷尬……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 由早到晚開的士，乘客來自四方八面，目的地亦各有不同，的士司機可算見盡人生百態，新聞掏寶重溫2003年專題，看看當年的的士司機搵食如何艱難。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵 及 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 大埔宏福苑宏志閣暫時解封，這集繼續了解更多住戶重返單位收拾物品的情況。有事主女兒向《東張》報料，指父親疑遭銀行女經理詐騙近百萬元。該經理因工作關係跟事主熟絡，還不時透過短訊與其進行私人對話。其後女經理向事主借款，事主也多次在分行大額提款並交給女經理，對方卻聲稱會帶回銀行處理？女兒曾向銀行投訴女經理涉嫌違規，銀行一方竟回覆事件屬於私人糾紛……另外，節目還會帶來有助修身的健康資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之開心速遞#2695粵
programme.desc: 立法會換屆選舉即將舉行，眾人談及此事，提到不少涉及社會政策的民生事項，需要由立法會議員向政府反映意見，因此投票選出可為市民發聲的議員極為重要。城安卻漠不關心，投票意欲欠奉。另一方面，社區中心因欠缺經費維修而暫時關閉，在現任立法會議員助理的協力幫忙下，事情得以解決。眾人對該助理讚譽有加，城安心生妒忌，竟在對方網上直播期間故意「搞事」。其後，城安受到該助理啟發終於知錯，並決意積極參與投票……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：新聞女王2#17粵
programme.desc: 殿堂級記者阮雪君榮獲「威爾斯火炬獎」後衣錦還鄉，其風頭與氣勢比慧心更盛。肇華派人暗中查探雪君的往事，要阻撓方太招攬雪君加入SNK分薄自己的勢力。祝捷晚宴上，雪君當眾猛烈抨擊網媒不負責任，與慧心的理念衝撞，二人針鋒相對，各不相讓。肇華趁火打劫，揭露慧心與雪君的秘密關係……詩晴策劃八台聯播採訪雪君，要激發媒體競爭的同時，也為建立自身功績。八台聯播期間，肇華竟拋出一個有關慧心童年遭遇的震撼彈……

programme.title: 去有風的地方#13粵普
programme.desc: 曉春請紅豆吃飯，之遙同去，卻遇到之前拒絕見面的相親女孩。飯後之遙氣紅豆幫倒忙，但晚上一得知紅豆發燒，又急忙趕去醫院。之遙因勸架被抓傷，紅豆幫他上藥，氣氛曖昧，之遙久久難以平靜，終於在紅豆臨走前表白。

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：帶阿姐看世界粵
programme.desc: 阮浩棕接棒帶阿姐往摩洛哥「看世界」，還貼心準備「Liza遮」為其擋太陽。第一站行逛卡薩布蘭卡市集，阿姐藉薄荷茶感受當地好客之道。置身海景餐廳歎地道料理，浩棕卻向不吃牛肉的阿姐致歉？屹立海面上的宗教地標，散發濃厚的神聖與藝術氣息，二人眼界大開！舍夫沙萬有「藍色之城」美譽，阿姐穿梭美麗小巷盡情打卡，展現購物不講價一面，浩棕更一探民居內的夢幻角落。品嚐當地私房菜風味，浩棕趁機向阿姐探問與家英哥的生活事。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 及時雨信貸呈獻:使徒行者2#24粵PG
programme.desc: 淑梅發現嘉莉似是受了傷，便向卓凱報告，卓凱關心嘉莉的傷勢。淑梅為了尋找少鋒，竟犯險前往福和酒家，天堂出現救了淑梅，最終淑梅為了幫助少鋒，把所知的事告知天堂。卓凱得知歡喜逃去，知有大事發生，決定請好友兼O記的康道行出手相助。歡喜主動與Johnny見面並刺激他，令Johnny對歡喜動殺機……嘉莉放假到別處散心，卓凱到來陪伴，鼓勵她追尋自由，走回正途。

programme.title: 茶煲世家#49粵
programme.desc: Janet結識新男友，對她百般遷就，耀國等暗地譏諷他有失男子體面。子東等在酒樓用膳時，鄰旁有情侶的言談極為痴纏，竟是耀國。翌日，子東要他帶女友Daisy露面，發覺Daisy專橫野蠻，對耀國的人身自由與經濟完全管束，耀國大為反感，終提出分手。耀國空虛之際，很快便結識貌若天仙新女友Angel，對耀國言聽計從，甚有賢妻良母風範，加上家底豐厚，令同事們羨慕不已，怎料其後發現她是空手道高手，眾人都大嚇一跳。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#1粵普PG
programme.desc: 羅十一娘在回京路上偶遇官府捉拿海盜，期間落水為徐令宜所救，卻以為恩人另有其人。十一娘察覺這次回京事有蹊蹺，關鍵就在徐家春宴。令宜以加賜爵位換取皇上對海禁鬆口，令羅元娘不滿，病重的她誓要為兒子鋪好前路。

programme.title: 關你家事粵PG
programme.desc: 承上集。年輕事主Wilson分享父親變本加厲的家暴惡行，以及自己離家出走的經過。抑壓多年的Wilson有次忍無可忍，與爸爸大打出手，令父子關係雪上加霜。沒想到事隔多時，家暴困局浮現轉機，而父子和好的關鍵正正發生在Wilson生日那天……家暴所帶來的心理恐懼，並非一聲道歉能夠驅散。肥媽、林雅詩同病相憐，兩位過來人聲淚剖白箇中掙扎。家庭治療師程翠雲又是否鼓勵因家暴而分離的夫妻，為了兒女着想而重修舊好？

programme.title: 關你家事粵PG
programme.desc: 25歲的元仔與妺妹Cynthia小時候，曾撞破爸爸與一位陌生女士態度親暱，又發現他暗地收藏女性裸照、在電話進行曖昧交談等。種種跡象暗示元仔的爸爸大搞外遇，加上父親漠視家庭，令一家人溫馨不再。元仔怨恨父親未有為家庭付出努力，雙方關係陷入僵局。英姐身為元仔、Cynthia的母親，應在子女還小時如實相告丈夫不忠的真相嗎？且聽藝人嘉賓黃智賢、家庭治療師狄志遠和現場觀眾分享看法。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
茶煲世家#50粵
programme.desc: 子敏受同學慫恿，利用買參考書的折扣差價買化妝品，麗娟和子東悉子敏不誠實而不悅。子東接到一男子找子敏的電話，恐他教壞子敏而詳加盤問，子敏尷尬又不滿。子敏同學不慎打爛人家的東西要照價賠償，向子敏等求助，子敏向麗娟借零用，麗娟不肯。一天，麗娟從街坊口中得知子敏在快餐店兼職賺錢，擔心女兒受騙，著子東兄弟到快餐店了解，竟見子敏被一肥仔帶到後巷，子敏並給對方錢，二人見狀即挾持肥仔，經解釋後始知一場誤會。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#2粵普
programme.desc: 十一娘與兩位姐姐來徐家參加春日宴，席間，程國公府的喬蓮房應元娘要求帶眾人去放紙鳶，二娘跟去；元娘帶十一娘撞破徐令宜和蓮房獨處一室，元娘逼迫蓮房嫁入徐府做妾，十一娘看穿元娘設局，猜出自己被挑中做繼室。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 「乾燒伊麵」是中式酒樓、茶餐廳常見的美食，原來做法並不複雜。鼎爺帶阿譚探視製作伊麵的繁複工序後，隨即向家庭觀眾傳授這味「鑊氣」十足的麵食。桂花魚肉質鮮美，廣受普羅家庭的喜愛。鼎爺將桂花魚去骨起肉後切成魚片，再捲起蘆荀及金華火腿絲，蒸煮成味道、賣相兼備的「桂花魚卷」。紅豆沙糖水簡單易做，但要令紅豆沙「起沙」卻要花點功夫。鼎爺巧手奉上「陳皮蓮子百合紅豆沙」，口感香濃綿密、「啖啖沙」，教人垂涎三尺！

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 小腸氣的學名是疝氣，常見於男性、長者與肥胖人士。外科醫生指小腸氣有機會影響腸道血液循環，嚴重時更可導致腸壞死。小腸氣主要透過手術治療，傳統與微創手術各有甚麼優點？旅行天文攝影愛好者暢談緣何自小培養觀星興趣，並介紹觀星的魅力。他提醒觀星時要遵守的基本禮儀，如拍照切勿使用閃光燈。嘉賓推介大埔山區、離島的觀星熱點，也會展示其星空攝影作品，分享深刻觀星經歷。「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅示範「三黃蛋」。

programme.title: 意外現場粵
programme.desc: 有米新郎與拜金新娘有情人終成眷屬，豈料結婚過程險象環生，喜慶現場變成意外現場。攝影師採用航拍技術拍攝婚照，卻不擅操控令航拍機變成傷人武器，現時可有相關法例規管？在斑馬線停留拍照會觸犯交通條例，花車佈置飾物更有可能令司機干犯不小心駕駛。婚宴開席前邀請賓客圍坐「耍樂」，會否構成非法聚賭？兄弟團投入玩樂引致頻頻受傷，還幸有救傷隊代表在場予以正確急救。新郎於宴席上心臟病發不幸離世，臨終遺言竟釀成爭產風波？

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#9粵PG
programme.desc: 冠一、柏義到天龍舊居，傾談下一步行動。正花向冠一求證心中疑惑，冠一的態度儼如陌生人，正花傷心。駿昇為月華準備了生日宴，再向她表白，月華表明仍掛念天龍。冠一、柏義遭人追殺，月華求駿昇停止行動。柏義突然向曦昕提出分手，坦言自己是天龍之子，還被駿昇追殺。曦昕找駿昇對質，駿昇對找到天龍之子感高興，還邀請柏義加入娛樂城董事局。正花喝醉，在麻將桌上自揭出千，只求被人打死……

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 為找尋海中妖怪題材的書籍，第三協榮丸來到忍術學校的圖書室，並在那裡遇上圖書委員能勢久作。協榮丸趁機向能勢炫耀自己的知識與教養，但是當能勢說起圖書委員顧問松千代老師的本領，便令協榮丸感到羞恥，不禁逃走…

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 兒童節目《Hands Up》有「醬汁家族」成員和一眾主持，陪伴大家度過愉快時光。「Kids’ Notes」邀請不同界別人士，跟小朋友分享有趣事物；透過「勇闖小兵團」遊戲，讓孩子們快樂遊玩；運動教練引領大家「Workout 2gether」，鍛練身體；還會透過「Artspiration」，引領孩子了解藝術世界；「My Little Show」開放表演舞台，小朋友到來盡情展示才藝！

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 陽葵終於要接受學生會的訓練，但她完全跟不上學生會成員的步伐，切身感受到自身實力不足，信心受挫。美月見狀，便帶著陽葵前往偶像公主空間到處遊玩。正當美月有事走開時，陽葵遇到一個黑髮的神秘少女。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 今日有樓睇粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
programme.desc: 東涌一個近1,000平方呎單位，設計師利用焗漆面板，把海景引入室內，配合燈光豐富層次，效果如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之開心速遞#2696粵
programme.desc: 敢威的專用車位遭人佔用，於是命馬漢張貼措辭強硬的告示，以示阻嚇。馬漢「照辦」，但告示的行文卻引來非議。敢威只好辯稱口語化告示有不少好處，還決定將公司所有告示一律改為口語化。這些告示雖然成功引起眾人關注，虹豆沙湯遠卻覺得不妥。其後，有神秘人蓄意撕毀告示，保安部亦束手無策。鐵面陳提到可能是沙湯遠所為，並向敢威提出由他本人負責重新張貼告示，獲得批准……鐵面陳銳意糾正口語化的弊病，卻引發新的問題……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：新聞女王2#18粵
programme.desc: 詩晴不滿肇華騎劫八台聯播，並搶走焦點。SNK進一步揭露慧心不為人知的過去，雪君逼使慧心勇敢面對童年陰影。慧心與雪君亮相公開平台，親身剖白塵封多年的真相與傷痛……無論真相如何，揭露慧心瘡疤只是肇華計劃中的一小部份，其背後的主要目的已經達到。歐洲新聞機構NovusVera計劃進軍香港傳媒市場，代理人雪君出手招兵買馬，率先以高薪厚職招攬家妍，並找詩晴合作為其居中牽線；慧心卻對外資攻港傳聞甚表質疑……

programme.title: 去有風的地方#14粵普
programme.desc: 之遙送紅豆到機場，兩人不捨擁抱告別。紅豆祭拜南星，分享雲南照片和回憶。之遙因思念紅豆而心情低落，奶奶送贈存摺鼓勵他追求紅豆。紅豆寄來桃子，之遙分享給鄉親。之遙迎接書店老闆，拍照傳紅豆，紅豆留言祝順利。

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：帶阿姐看世界粵
programme.desc: 皮革製品是摩洛哥主要輸出品之一，非斯更保留傳統染缸工藝。途經峽谷景點，阿姐、浩棕一探當地嬉水、露營的家庭樂。踏足有逾九千條巷子的非斯古城，隨時會迷路？一睹古法皮染手藝的豐富「色彩」，浩棕更踩上大染缸打卡，背後卻要忍受難頂氣味！買皮革製品做手信，阿姐突擊提問感情事，浩棕即口窒窒……遊走「迷城」選購傳統服飾，還有幸參觀當地人住所，感受風土人情。居民拉茶、擊鼓盛情招待，兩主持興致大發，跟隨節奏舞動起來。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
及時雨信貸呈獻:使徒行者2#25粵PG
programme.desc: 嘉莉回港後提出要離開德信，德信嘗試挽留。少鋒利用替死鬼引出雪晴和其他黑警，主動出擊與眾黑警槍戰，但最終也中彈受傷，只得託撻Q從內地回港幫助他。黑白兩道追捕少鋒，幸卓凱及時救了他，少鋒感動，終向卓凱道出自己的秘密及所知，卓凱將少鋒安置在安全屋。大輝帶天堂來到安全屋，天堂方知受命追殺少鋒，來不及通知少鋒一眾。歡喜帶走少鋒，還提議與他聯手合作，對付德信及黑警。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 茶煲世家#50粵
programme.desc: 子敏受同學慫恿，利用買參考書的折扣差價買化妝品，麗娟和子東悉子敏不誠實而不悅。子東接到一男子找子敏的電話，恐他教壞子敏而詳加盤問，子敏尷尬又不滿。子敏同學不慎打爛人家的東西要照價賠償，向子敏等求助，子敏向麗娟借零用，麗娟不肯。一天，麗娟從街坊口中得知子敏在快餐店兼職賺錢，擔心女兒受騙，著子東兄弟到快餐店了解，竟見子敏被一肥仔帶到後巷，子敏並給對方錢，二人見狀即挾持肥仔，經解釋後始知一場誤會。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#2粵普
programme.desc: 十一娘與兩位姐姐來徐家參加春日宴，席間，程國公府的喬蓮房應元娘要求帶眾人去放紙鳶，二娘跟去；元娘帶十一娘撞破徐令宜和蓮房獨處一室，元娘逼迫蓮房嫁入徐府做妾，十一娘看穿元娘設局，猜出自己被挑中做繼室。

programme.title: 區區開伙粵
programme.desc: 由謝霆鋒提供構思的「黑蒜蓉包」是甚麼味道？家燕姐帶隊到北角區探索。麥包、張美妮帶林欣彤品嚐該區的港式瑞士汁、馬來西亞、潮州滋味。大王、李錦聯精選素食館，新派傳統自助餐兼備，還少不免結伴掃街尋各路美食！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
一路前行II粵普
programme.desc: 節目由胡歌、劉濤和陳龍攜手中國國家地理融媒體中心主任張辰亮以及一眾新朋友，在節目中帶觀眾走進自然，走進科學研究員、環保愛好者和當地居民的生活工作。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 巴基斯坦的木爾坦, 南亞最古老的城市。陪伴木爾坦人穿越沙漠的駱駝對他們來說是很珍貴的存在 死後的駱駝更被製作成駱駝皮燈，再畫上傳統的納卡什圖案，為木爾坦人照亮黑暗的盡頭

programme.title: 排檔尋情味粵英
programme.desc: 走進新加坡不同世代小販的生活，感受他們之間的關愛、爭吵以及他們對彼此堅定不移的支持。

programme.title: 西葡潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 梁芷珮不忘觀賞葡萄牙足球比賽，雖然置身作客場區，但於現場的熾熱氣氛下，仍可全情投入精彩比拼，High爆！除了睇波，緊記參觀當地著名球隊的博物館，踏入球員通道、更衣室、歷史專區，足球鐵粉盡情打卡。芷珮到訪沙甸魚罐頭工場，難得窺探國民美食的製作過程，她試製的手信又有多獨特？在工場餐廳品嚐「罐頭菜」，吞拿魚芝士蛋糕散發濃情滋味，有驚喜！到訪逾三百年歷史的酒莊，試飲味道清甜的波特酒，順道分享品酒小知識。

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 長洲兩日一夜之旅，如何玩得特色又出色？陳志健、黃子恆、何浩文來到西灣一個歷奇探險聖地，玩盡飛索、平衡車等新奇刺激玩意，期間還徒手攀上樹頂，莫非他們打算挑戰新一代「包山王」？三位男生踏足全島最高的「北眺亭」，又到五行石欣賞無敵海景，只為尋找「男人的浪漫」！街邊小吃「越吃越精采」，自己親手炮製的「長洲芒果糯米糍」，滋味又如何？住長洲也可以住得有「營」，節目介紹島上特色營地，體驗印第安與歐陸風情。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 第六感亦稱直覺或預感，是人類一種非透過五種基本感官所獲得的感知能力。谷主瀅仴自認直覺準確，甚至能分辨對方可有說謊，例如是前戀人。泳嘉、凱婷亦分享各自的預感經歷，凱婷還整理了網上的第六感敏銳度測試。三位谷主討論男、女性的第六感差異，並帶出顯意識與潛意識的概念，瀅仴更笑言這集可為不少「欠細心」的男朋友平反，何出此言？凱婷亦提出有助訓練第六感的方法，清潔房間、定期按摩也可能是有效途徑之一？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 請1日假去旅行粵
programme.desc: 余思霆收拾好行李，請一日假便飛台北，獲地膽拍檔金剛接機，即搭機場捷運向市中心出發！旅程第一餐品嚐足料雞腿湯，未吃完已心思思要到寧夏夜市，尋覓同獲「車胎人」推介的芋餅、豬肝湯與蚵仔煎。日間於隱世咖啡店享用三層塔茶點，夜晚深入窄巷酒吧，啟動門口機關，走進以蜂巢為主題的設計格局並淺酌一番。翌晨，兩人排長龍買早餐，再登上公園邊賞花邊醫肚，偏黑色的滷肉飯有多滋味？下午行程有兩款選擇，歎啡、浸溫泉，悉隨尊便。

programme.title: 請1日假去旅行粵
programme.desc: 旅途第二晚，吃到盡！先有抵食海鮮加肉材一人一鍋，其他配料、蔬菜任添，再來意想不到的鹽酥雞當宵夜；連放鬆做Spa都有點心吃？第三日早上，兩大行程可揀，好動的可以滑水，金剛體驗「沙發滑水」，感受如何？愛靜的可跟思霆往赤峰街商圈做個文青，購物、打卡、來個小清新套餐。終極血拼階段，到永康街一帶尋找合適手信，台灣特色小食、茶葉、精緻生活小物，任君選擇。上機前再享用炭火烹製的薑母鴨，記住金剛建議最後才吃鴨肉！

programme.title: 黃金盛宴粵
programme.desc: 黃金盛宴隆重舉行，蔡瀾、曾志偉、薛家燕、莫樹錦、周中、謝寧、周汶錡應邀赴宴，由名貴魚子醬與蟹肉頭盤掀起序幕。周中還得Amanda S即磨黑松露片，美味直送入口。諾懿、保哥合力炮製軟殼龍蝦天婦羅，讓來賓免剝殼嚐味。Jacques即席重現經典「后冠小牛排」；鼎爺將東星斑片肉，再由諾懿用油泡熟，附上鮮甜魚湯。肥媽「貴族黃油雞」、阿爺「黃金炒飯」先後奉上，還有壓軸巨形聖多諾黑蛋糕，皆獲貴賓們高度評價！

programme.title: 快樂奇蹟粵
programme.desc: 肺癌康復者羅翠媚曾被斷定只可多活兩個月，尤幸得到服用新藥的機會，病情亦逐漸受控。當她以為逃過鬼門關如常上班之際，腫瘤卻再次出現，而背後元兇可能是困擾不少港人的工作壓力？親友的鼓勵，如何再讓健康奇蹟降臨？芭蕾舞者雷晴雯因意外導致脊椎嚴重受創，自此不能走動。但她拒絕與輪椅結伴度過餘生，並決定獨自前赴台灣接受治療，堅毅個性最終為她逆轉人生！喜劇、笑片被指是能醫百病的心靈良藥，箇中說法更有臨床實證支持。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵PG
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普
programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普
programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普
programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這次運動訓練集中強化腹部和臀部，熱身好就馬上開始！躺下後利用腹部力量，嘗試將雙手碰腳尖、左右腳輪流上下移動，已有不少挑戰。其後教練要大家維持「平板姿勢」，將雙腳輪流輕碰手肘；再以水樽作為負重，做「俄羅斯轉體」，又能否應付得來？輪到臀部訓練，身體向前傾，完成直腿後踢與側踢。躺下做的動作會比較省力，但亦要留意一些細節，才能集中用到臀部發力。趴下做直腳上踢動作時，腰部要緊貼瑜伽墊，做起來也有一定難度。

programme.title: 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日
programme.desc: 戴雅一行目擊一顆類似流星的光球，這跟導致他們穿越時空的光球一模一樣，繼而決定找出光球墜落的地方。就在搜索途中，他們再次成為肉食恐龍的獵物！三人能否逃出生天，找到光球，回到原來的時代呢？

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 城崎與花輪最近言談甚歡，距離親近，令小渚深感不安，更哀求小丸子與小玉追查二人的關係。事實上，是城崎為了參加狗狗比賽，跟隨花輪學習馴犬方法。小渚知情後，便拉上愛犬孤挺花，像城崎一樣請教花輪。

programme.title: 榮寶齋粵
programme.desc: 節目聚焦榮寶齋代代堅守、薪火相傳的百年歷程，透過榮寶齋這一中國文化與藝術發展的重要縮影，展現中國傳統文化的魅力與蓬勃的生命力。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
香港中旅集團呈獻：新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 《新聞透視》，每周專題報道多段香港以至國際的矚目新聞，聚焦港人最關心的民生話題，並邀請各界人士、學者、專家，一同深入探討箇中來龍去脈。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: Z 風暴粵
programme.desc: 一日，眼部受傷的女人突然出現在廉署總部，揚言要控告商業罪案調查科警司彬（林家棟飾）貪污，執行處首席調查主任廉（古天樂飾）接手調查，在追查過程中，廉發現身為警司的彬在執行職務時利用職權參與犯罪…

programme.title: 風味人間粵
programme.desc: 內蒙古於九月迎來莜麥的收成，其脂肪含量豐富，在地人會用來製成不同形狀的麵食。地處非洲的埃塞俄比亞則盛產苔麩，同樣富含油脂，所製的英吉拉是當地主糧。廣西侗族民眾為慶祝嬰兒誕生，會用經鹽、糯米發酵製成的酸豇豆、酸肉等款待親友，而酸鴨甚至醃製長達五年之久？冰島人仍沿用古法，先藉發酵分解鯊魚肉內的毒素，再脫水風乾，風味獨特。湖北荊州人會把江魚起肉製成魚糕；另將魚尾煎香，即成當地日常早餐。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 香港賽車手歐陽若曦正式退役，回望輝煌旅途有何感受？他還提到希望培育女兒參與賽車運動。保齡球世錦賽、香港壁球公開賽分別舉行，港隊主場出戰，表現怎樣？戶外羽毛球世界盃將在阿聯酋上演，港隊積極備戰。板網球銀級賽匯聚逾二百位球手，送上比拼花絮。AI系統融入運動，如何藉分析動作來改善運動員水平？另帶來學生運動員動向，重劍港青代表羅阡滺細說赴馬來西亞交流得着；滾軸女將趙奭孜談及於亞錦賽青年組速度過樁摘銀點滴。

programme.title: 勁歌金榜粵
programme.desc: 主持許文軒(Edmond)每集緊貼金榜最新形勢。此外，節目送上歌曲MV之餘，Edmond還會帶來歌手或音樂人的訪問，跟觀眾暢談作品，以至樂壇的人和事。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 中信股份呈獻：財經透視粵
programme.desc: 《財經透視》緊貼大市，回顧每周港股走勢外，並關注樓市狀況，透過業界人士專訪、市場分析等，深入淺出探討本港、國際財經金融熱門話題，更以專題形式報道不同行業發展面對的問題。

programme.title: 新鮮人#15粵
programme.desc: 韋文、麗華正努力地清潔「材記」，欲替家輝籌備裝修公司，家輝感激，決重振雄風。麗華得韋文熱情相助，對她是韋權之妹的偏見全消。家謙、阮盈經常相約出外，韋文強要跟隨，卻備受冷落。自阮盈有家輝、家謙照顧，DY再沒有跟蹤她。家輝的裝修公司開張，韋文請眾人到母玉琴之齋鋪吃飯慶祝，韋文不敢將暗戀家謙之事告訴玉琴，只敢向父成峰傾訴。韋文提議飯後到卡拉OK，並於深夜宣佈自己生日，怎枓各人突然離去，剩韋文孤獨渡過。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 長洲兩日一夜之旅，如何玩得特色又出色？陳志健、黃子恆、何浩文來到西灣一個歷奇探險聖地，玩盡飛索、平衡車等新奇刺激玩意，期間還徒手攀上樹頂，莫非他們打算挑戰新一代「包山王」？三位男生踏足全島最高的「北眺亭」，又到五行石欣賞無敵海景，只為尋找「男人的浪漫」！街邊小吃「越吃越精采」，自己親手炮製的「長洲芒果糯米糍」，滋味又如何？住長洲也可以住得有「營」，節目介紹島上特色營地，體驗印第安與歐陸風情。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 第六感亦稱直覺或預感，是人類一種非透過五種基本感官所獲得的感知能力。谷主瀅仴自認直覺準確，甚至能分辨對方可有說謊，例如是前戀人。泳嘉、凱婷亦分享各自的預感經歷，凱婷還整理了網上的第六感敏銳度測試。三位谷主討論男、女性的第六感差異，並帶出顯意識與潛意識的概念，瀅仴更笑言這集可為不少「欠細心」的男朋友平反，何出此言？凱婷亦提出有助訓練第六感的方法，清潔房間、定期按摩也可能是有效途徑之一？

programme.title: 香港本色粵
programme.desc: 黃大仙祠是香港著名的廟宇之一，黃大仙「信仰習俗」亦成功入選國家級非物質文化遺產名錄。傳統上，道長的職責是世代相傳，若年輕人希望接觸傳統，成為道長，有何方法加入？相傳黃大仙在民間贈醫施藥，我們不難發現「普濟勸善」的精神在香港根深蒂固，不少團體亦會為有需要的市民提供免費診症服務。除此之外，社會上還有甚麼慈善活動與黃大仙有關？節目亦會介紹各種道服，「主科」、「幽科」、「青衣」等是在甚麼場合穿着？

programme.title: 快樂奇蹟粵

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 巴基斯坦的木爾坦, 南亞最古老的城市。陪伴木爾坦人穿越沙漠的駱駝對他們來說是很珍貴的存在 死後的駱駝更被製作成駱駝皮燈，再畫上傳統的納卡什圖案，為木爾坦人照亮黑暗的盡頭

programme.title: 排檔尋情味粵英
programme.desc: 走進新加坡不同世代小販的生活，感受他們之間的關愛、爭吵以及他們對彼此堅定不移的支持。

programme.title: 一路前行II粵普
programme.desc: 節目由胡歌、劉濤和陳龍攜手中國國家地理融媒體中心主任張辰亮以及一眾新朋友，在節目中帶觀眾走進自然，走進科學研究員、環保愛好者和當地居民的生活工作。

programme.title: 往哪跑！
programme.desc: 俄羅斯經典動畫系列新作！歡樂悠閒的羅莎渡假村，歡迎世界各地的旅客，在此度過最放鬆的假期！然而，調皮的狼總是想和兔子一爭高下，藉此吸引鹿小姐的注意！

programme.title: 往哪跑！
programme.desc: 俄羅斯經典動畫系列新作！歡樂悠閒的羅莎渡假村，歡迎世界各地的旅客，在此度過最放鬆的假期！然而，調皮的狼總是想和兔子一爭高下，藉此吸引鹿小姐的注意！

programme.title: 哈皮樂奇鬧翻天
programme.desc: 哈皮和樂奇是鄰居，他們跟帕普和邦迪一起住在鄉下。哈皮和樂奇之間相處得很愉快，他們的生活充滿了搞笑和歡樂。

programme.title: 功夫莫特
programme.desc: 莫特跟隨師父修行了十年，但一直都只能處理一些和修練無關的瑣事，某天，他們的村莊被妖怪入侵，師父命令莫特去解救村民，並囑咐不可以真面貌示人，執行任務時，必須帶著一個奇怪面具。對於這樣的指示，莫特並不開心。因為所有的村民，包括他暗戀的妙仙，都非常崇拜著面具道士，所以莫特越來越想告訴大家真相…

programme.title: 燦爛的風和海(完)
programme.desc: 【賽車手失意澳門 邂逅冷豔策展人共度浪漫情緣】在燈火輝煌的攝影棚與璀璨奪目的澳門之間，廣告導演麥又歌為夢想與責任奔波，結識熱心單純的機車青年徐君樂，在彼此的陪伴下逐漸打開封閉的心門。同時，賽車手韓俊豪在失利陰影與媒體質疑中掙扎，卻因邂逅神秘策展人陳嘉慧，而重新燃起追尋自我的勇氣。四人在工作、夢想與愛情的交織裡相遇，既面對現實的壓力，也學會傾聽心底的渴望。在陌生卻絢爛的城市裡，他們將一同經歷命運的考驗，找尋屬於自己的方向。

programme.title: 我的魯蛇舅舅
programme.desc: 【翻拍BBC人氣英劇／魯蛇舅舅Ｘ強迫症外甥溫馨爆笑的家庭喜劇】由《雖然是精神病但沒關係》的自閉症哥哥吳正世，首次擔任男主角，在選秀節目中獲勝的他，本該朝歌手夢前進，不料積蓄突然遭朋友騙光，從此一蹶不振，成為無業遊名。某天因為姊姊與家暴丈夫離婚，而開始照顧起強迫症的外甥，過程中兩人總是不斷鬥嘴，關係相愛又相殺，而他也從中找回責任感，成為外甥的超人舅舅。

programme.title: 陌生人
programme.desc: 【怪力媽搭配毒舌女母女笑鬧同居火花不斷】一個是凡事衝動、毫無對策的媽媽，一個是灑脫率性、走自己路的女兒。原本就像陌生人一樣的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，雞飛狗跳成為日常。從降職的糗事、誤會的桃色風波，到接連不斷的麻煩事件，她們在鬥嘴中暗暗守護彼此。越是嫌棄對方，越是離不開對方——這場「陌生人同居記」，意外寫下母女間最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫朴一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子朴言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而朴言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 我的魯蛇舅舅
programme.desc: 【翻拍BBC人氣英劇／魯蛇舅舅Ｘ強迫症外甥溫馨爆笑的家庭喜劇】由《雖然是精神病但沒關係》的自閉症哥哥吳正世，首次擔任男主角，在選秀節目中獲勝的他，本該朝歌手夢前進，不料積蓄突然遭朋友騙光，從此一蹶不振，成為無業遊名。某天因為姊姊與家暴丈夫離婚，而開始照顧起強迫症的外甥，過程中兩人總是不斷鬥嘴，關係相愛又相殺，而他也從中找回責任感，成為外甥的超人舅舅。

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S4
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的岩漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 逆轉女王
programme.desc: 【經典韓劇《賢內助女王》姊妹作】黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚。然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助。五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場。在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長。泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標。

programme.title: 最佳愛情
programme.desc: 【知名編劇「洪氏姊妹」執筆當紅VS過氣偶像間的戀愛羅曼史】正值演藝巔峰的獨孤振，不但是廣告界寵兒，更是國民好感度第一的男星！而具愛貞則是前當紅偶像團體「國寶少女」成員，因過氣只好跑跑通告維持生計。獨孤振在一次試鏡中，因英語程度不佳，丟失了出演機會，沒想到這丟人的祕密，居然被具愛貞給知道了！國民喜愛的男星碰上國民唾棄的女星，他們能克服眾人的偏見勇敢去愛嗎?一場荒謬又有趣的浪漫戀曲即將展開。

programme.title: 陷入純情(完)
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 最佳愛情
programme.desc: 【知名編劇「洪氏姊妹」執筆當紅VS過氣偶像間的戀愛羅曼史】正值演藝巔峰的獨孤振，不但是廣告界寵兒，更是國民好感度第一的男星！而具愛貞則是前當紅偶像團體「國寶少女」成員，因過氣只好跑跑通告維持生計。獨孤振在一次試鏡中，因英語程度不佳，丟失了出演機會，沒想到這丟人的祕密，居然被具愛貞給知道了！國民喜愛的男星碰上國民唾棄的女星，他們能克服眾人的偏見勇敢去愛嗎?一場荒謬又有趣的浪漫戀曲即將展開。

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 【改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！】擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨。某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 愛情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永攜手《社內相親》薛仁雅尋找幸福小確幸！！！】清雅是一名放棄戀愛和結婚，努力在生活中，連續八年準備警察公務員卻無法合格的社會小螺絲。俊輝則是一名對他人毫無興趣的不婚主義者，不管是愛情、友情還是親情都秉持N分之一的態度。認識了彼此開始尋找瑣碎但現實的小確幸，並開始認知愛情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: ONE Fight Night 38: Andrade vs. Baatarkhuu
programme.desc: The stars will shine the brightest when the world’s largest martial arts organization returns to the Thai capital for ONE Fight Night 38: Andrade vs. Baatarkhuu. This blockbuster showcase features several martial arts veterans, and it will be topped by a pair of must-see World Title battles. In the headline attraction, ONE Bantamweight MMA World Champion Fabricio Andrade looks to continue his reign of devastation and cap off the year with another highlight-reel knockout for the ages. But #4-ranked contender Enkh-Orgil Baatarkhuu, who is fresh off his appearance on Netflix’s Physical: 100, wants to follow in the footsteps of his mentor Narantungalag Jadambaa and become the next Mongolian to capture ONE World Title gold. In the co-main event, two-time ADCC World Champion Diogo “Baby Shark” Reis will square off against Japanese BJJ black belt Daiki Yonekura for the ONE Flyweight Submission Grappling World Title. Plus, British Muay Thai legend Liam Harrison, BJJ icon Marcelo Garcia...

programme.title: Baby Einstein - On the Go: Riding, Sailing and Soaring

programme.title: Giselle and the Green Team - The Case of the Ransacked Reef - EP206
programme.desc: Gisele and her Green Team fight Nick Slick from ruining the coral reefs in the Phillippines.

programme.title: Rainbow Rangers S2 - Chimp in the Wild Shake It - EP217
programme.desc: The Rangers check whether their chimp friend Ernest is ready to return to the wild; after a terrible earthquake, the Rangers try to save a group of ducks.

programme.title: Thomas Edison's Secret Lab - Burpin’ Babies Backpack Payback - EP118
programme.desc: Kent’s youth serum works a little too well and turns the gang into screaming babies. The serum soon wears off – sort of – now they’re adults trapped in baby bodies and Von Bolt doesn’t know whether to obey or burp them. When the Anti-Matters steal JD's backpack and discover the portable ALVA, they unwittingly cause Edison's hologram to disappear. The Secret Lab Kids must concoct a plan to retrieve the backpack before Edison's lost forever.

programme.desc: Warren, the SMC, and Starty travel to Camelot on a Quest for Six Golden Rules that will save Young Arthur's Kingdom.

programme.title: Superhero Kindergarten - Austrian Adventure - EP125

programme.title: Shaq's Garage - My Frozen Friend - EP113
programme.desc: Gronk runs into the Abominable Snowman.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Zexal - The Sparrow, Part 1 - EP7
programme.desc: The story takes place in the distant future and focuses on a boy named Yuma Tsukumo, the number one bad boy at his school. Something unexpected happens when Ryoga challenges him to a Duel as the mysterious ghost of Astral appears before them, a new legend begins.

programme.title: The Twisted Tales of Felix the Cat - The Twisted Tales of Felix the Cat Ep10 - EP110
programme.desc: The beyond surreal adventures of Felix The Cat and his friends set in an incredibly weird and fantastical toon world where everything is alive and only dream logic rules. Each episode has three segments.

programme.title: Baby Einstein - World of Rhythm
programme.desc: Your little one will want to keep a beat, snap his fingers and march his feet! Join new characters Pillie, the musical woodpecker, and Coco, the dancing cockatoo, and share the excitement of rhythm with your baby. World of Rhythm explores rhythm in music, rhythm in nature and rhythm as a form of expression.

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Differences - EP121
programme.desc: In this chapter, we will discover that culture is a way of life that is passed down from generation to generation, and through speaking of our differences we learn about other cultures. programme.desc: Roly is digging in the garden when his spade suddenly hits something. It's a key. But what does it do? Duggee has his key badge, they can find out through trial and error.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Hey Quacky!
programme.desc: Worm and Ladybird wonder what's going on at Squirrel Club. There's a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Golden Gate Bridge, USA
programme.desc: On a very foggy day, The Golden Gate Bridge's foghorns are missing. Can the Go Jetters help?

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch supersizes a fierce Komodo dragon, the Go Jetters must act fast!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Big Ben, England
programme.desc: The Go Jetters visit London on New Year's Eve, but Big Ben is missing! To the Vroomster!

programme.title: My World Kitchen (S3) - Pippa's Zimbabwean Nyama
programme.desc: Pippa's tasty nyama uses a young cabbage leaf called spring greens, along with lots of other delicious ingredients. Pippa's table is animal themed, using zebra prints and a toy giraffe!

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Baby European Pond Turtle
programme.desc: In this episode, Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to the Danube river in Vienna, Austria on a baby animal mission to help a newly hatched European pond turtle reach water. Along the way, the intrepid team witness the emergence of ten million mayflies.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S7) - Sandcastle Squish
programme.desc: Seaweed arrives on deck playing a new game called Sandcastle Squish on his console, but Captain Captain takes it off him and quickly becomes obsessed with it, neglecting her captain's duties. It's up to the pirates to try and get her to stop playing the game.

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Elephant Gets the Blues
programme.desc: The toys are having a racing game.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Pool
programme.desc: Packing for the pool, Bluey and Dad tease Mum about being so fussy with what to take. But when they arrive underprepared, they realise a little planning goes a long way.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Shops
programme.desc: Playing 'Shops' is the best game ever for Bluey and her friends - if they can ever get started! With Bluey questioning the rules and changing who's who, they might be here all day!

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Wagon Ride
programme.desc: Bluey can't wait to get to the monkey bars as Dad takes her and Bingo on a wagon ride to the park. But her patience is tested when Dad keeps stopping to chat with other grown-ups.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Wonder Pea
programme.desc: Supertato is delighted when Evil Pea becomes his sidekick but it's all a trick and Evil Pea captures him! Evil Pea is forced to do a good deed because one of the Cobs needs help.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S23) - Too Loud, Thomas!
programme.desc: After Thomas loses his voice, he must find a new way to pass on a very important message.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: Lover's Rock
programme.desc: Pan Lei, winner the China Literary Award for three consecutive years, wrote and directed this film about the lives and loves of a fishing village. It starred the glorious Cheng Pei-pei in her first film as a woman (she had debuted in a man's role), and her much-lauded performance won her the prestigious Golden Accolade Award from the International Association Of Independent Producers a first for any Asian woman.

programme.title: Songfest
programme.desc: As its name implies, Songfest is an Eastmancolor-Shawscope costume musical, traditionally Chinese and timeless in content; yet revealing a spirited and modern technique. Shot on location at Taiwan's beautiful Sun-Moon Lake, it's a turbulent romance between a passionate tea picker Sung Yu Lan and a charming fisherman Li Chun Yang.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: Martial Arts of Shaolin
programme.desc: Zhi Ming, who trains at the Northern Shaolin Temple, teams up with Si Ma Yan, who trains at the Southern Shaolin Temple, to avenge both their fathers' death by assassinating a corrupt magistrate, leading to a series of fierce battles!

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung's house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung's mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task and after being released, he vows to avenge his family by killing Fei.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his father's death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiancee enlists a swordsman-who secretly loves her-to search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed "The Invincible Fist" is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrate's daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yen's family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Lo's brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hu's house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hu's pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny appears to be an ordinary housewife but is in fact a mahjong expert. Deeply in love with her husband, she loses to a seductive woman, Curvy, both on the mahjong table and in competing for her husband's love. With the help from her mahjong master, Fanny vows to take on Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from To's father and bitter jealousy from her designated fiance, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the "Gang of Five" in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Love and Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says "yes". Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliff's ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: The Truth
programme.desc: Orphaned lawyer Raymond Lau once helped clear hooker Lan of murder charges, not knowing that Lan is his mother. When a corrupt cop blackmails Lan with Raymond's identity, she kills him out of desperation. When Raymond is enlisted again to defend Lan, he uncovers the secret that she has been hiding about their relationship for years.

programme.title: Romantic Dream
programme.desc: Dino meets his dream girl Mandy and falls in love with her at first sight. However, she disappears suddenly and he only sees her again after nine years, when she is already married. To overcome the pain of losing his love, Dino finds a guru with supernatural power to make him meet Mandy in his dream.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: The Eye 2
programme.desc: Joey looks to start a new life after a failed suicide attempt but finds herself pregnant and dare not tell her ex-boyfriend. At the same time, she realizes that a mysterious woman is stalking her and begins to hallucinate, leading to a nervous breakdown. Taking advice from an abbot, Joey decides to uncover the truth in order to protect her baby...

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: The Eye 10
programme.desc: This third installment of 'The Eye' horror movie series is about the creepy adventures of a group of teenagers who summon spirits by using the ten methods outlined in a mysterious comic book while vacationing in Thailand.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Golden Chicken 2
programme.desc: The sequel is set in 2046 when a 82-year-old Ah Kam stops a heartbroken young man from taking memory loss pills. To help ease his pain, Ah Kam shares her life stories from 2003, one of Hong Kong's toughest year with SARS, including the different people she comes across and the bittersweet romance between herself and her cousin.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: The Chinese Feast
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: Kill Time
programme.desc: Mak stumbles upon an obscure website "Witch's Zone" when looking for a copy of her dead father's favorite song. The mysterious website only allows one purchase but Mak cannot resist buying one more purple scarf. Not only does the scarf triggers her memories of her father and her first love, it may also be a vital clue in a mysterious murder.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: A Chinese Tall Story
programme.desc: While finding ways to rescue his disciples, Monk Tripitaka meets the lizard imp Mei Yan, the ugliest woman alive. Despite the conflict between good and evil, he falls for Mei Yan who sacrifices herself to save him many times. The Monk breaks his "no killing" rule to save his disciples, and things get more complicated as Princess Galaxy appears...

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Everlasting Love
programme.desc: Young intern doctor Eric meets Pei Jun and quickly falls in love with her, unaware that she works as a hostess in a night club. Despite their social differences, can their love story defy the odds and lead to a happily ever after?

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The famous "Gang Trio" is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million dollars. When they realize that the triad is after both the ransom and the baby's life, they decide to make the hostage their protege. Cornered by cops and threatened by gangsters, the three 'Rob-B-Hood' must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Long Arm of the Law Part 3
programme.desc: Chinese ex-soldier Li is wrongly accused and seeks refuge in Hong Kong to escape a death sentence. En route, he meets Sam and Moon. While Li has fallen in love with Moon, Hong Kong triad kidnaps Moon and coerces Li into aiding a robbery. Meanwhile, the mainland police officer tracks Li's path to Hong Kong, intensifying the chase.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Cold Open
programme.desc: Tom and the riders discover the Ice Realm and find Buzzsaw inside.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Uncharted Territory
programme.desc: Alex and Eugene find themselves at odds with Tom and their fellow dragon riders when Feathers and Webmaster go missing during a blizzard in the Ice Realm.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants And The Disturbing Dilemma Of The Dysfunctional Doppelgangers
programme.desc: The crew meets their blue-hued doppelgängers when they crash-land on an alien planet where kids call all the shots.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants And The Confusing Crisis Of The Conniving Captive
programme.desc: Melvin isn't exactly their friend ... but it's not like George and Harold can just let him be held captive by diabolical Biglyans, right? Right?!?

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants And The Aggravated Assault Of The Alien Armada
programme.desc: Oh, the indignity: George and Harold are forced to perform spa treatments on gigantic Biglyans. Also, Dr. Fitzgibbons reveals a shocking secret.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Saving Shattermaster
programme.desc: When Mala and the Defenders of the Wing find a mysterious stranger who looks suspiciously like Dagur, Hiccup and Heather go to investigate.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Dire Straits
programme.desc: Viggo gets angry at the dragon riders continually interfering with his business and uses a deep sea dragon, the Submaripper, to control Berk's trade.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S2 - Postmortem
programme.desc: Tensions run high within team Voltron as they discuss Lotor’s fate and try to figure out their next move

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Wrestlebabia: The Musica Flowers For Munk
programme.desc: When Sandy can't join animal wrestling she poses as "Mandy Monkhuahua"; In order to help Munk, Grug sticks super worms up his nose that make him smarter

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Jam Jam
programme.desc: The PALs try to figure out why Marciela is acting so weird, while Miradero is gripped by April Fool’s Day fever

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Bridge
programme.desc: A group of Trux displaced by a volcano comes to Ty for help, and the gang has to work together to build a bridge to welcome their new guests.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Lots Of Raa's In The Jungle
programme.desc: Raa Raa and all his friends are finding out about different animals, they charge around being a pride of lions, a tower of giraffes etc… until Zebby wonders what zebras do… together the animals discover that zebras stampede… which is great fun and very noisy!

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Favourite Things
programme.desc: Raa Raa wants to show Topsy his three favourite things. But when he gets to his friends house, they have disappeared. Raa Raa and his friends set out on a noisy adventure to find the missing objects

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Jungle Jiggles
programme.desc: Raa Raa wants a partner to dance a noisy stompy dance with. All the animals have their own way of dancing, apart from Zebby who says she is too shy to dance… or is she?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Great Big Noise
programme.desc: Raa Raa has decided that the jingly jangly jungle is not jingly or jangly enough. He and his friends make lots of noise, but soon learn that they need to work together to make a wonderful jingly jangly jungle noise.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Nap Time Story
programme.desc: Topsy is going to read Zebby a naptime story. Raa Raa wants to make the noises to go with the story. But they are all too loud and poor Zebby can't get to sleep. Can Raa Raa find any quiet sleepy noises in the Jingly Jangly Jungle?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Go Bananas
programme.desc: Ooo Ooo is having a banana party. Raa Raa and the others have picked masses of lovely bananas, but how are they going to transport them back to Ooo Ooo's in time for the party?

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ's Glow Ride
programme.desc: Gabby receives a special nighttime delivery, unboxing a glow-in-the-dark train engine. However, she realizes that she's missing the other three train cars to complete the whole train. The Gabby Cats help Gabby build the other three glow-in-the-dark train cars by creating shapes through interactivemusical games. In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, DJ Catnip sings a song.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Rainy Day Banana
programme.desc: With a little help from Gabby’s imagination, a sparkly toy banana turns into a magical Rainy Day Banana that helps Gabby and the Gabby Cats have fun on a rainy day! They have silly banana snacks with Cakey, make crafts to tell a story with Baby Box, and have an a-meow-zing banana dance party with DJ Catnip. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants And The Aggravated Assault Of The Alien Armada
programme.desc: Oh, the indignity: George and Harold are forced to perform spa treatments on gigantic Biglyans. Also, Dr. Fitzgibbons reveals a shocking secret.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Boom Baby
programme.desc: Looking to trim costs, Boss unknowingly fires Boom Baby, a super-undercover Baby Corp worker who displays to parents how unsafe things are by pratfalling on them and crying for attention. Convinced he's the victim of a conspiracy, Boom leaves a wake of parent worry in his path, forcing Boss to stop him.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Home Punch Home
programme.desc: Tired of the farm's feud with the neighboring punch monkeys, Ugga arranges a punch summit where the Bettermans and Croods will stay in the punch monkey village to learn how to all get along.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Featherhide
programme.desc: Tom and the others debate how to keep the dragons a secret, even as a rambunctious young "cloaking" dragon gets loose in town and pursues a friendship with a reluctant Alex.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Jin's New Look
programme.desc: On the brink of his highly-anticipated White Coat Ceremony at school, Jin proudly dons his new white doctor’s coat around town, unwittingly drawing the attention of a creature named Morty. After a slobbery lick from Morty, Jin turns invisible! As Jin frantically tries to become re-visible, he discovers that Morty is very pregnant! Ultimately, Jin foregoes his ceremony and instead delivers Morty’s five babies.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - Bad Luck Branch Gem Day
programme.desc: Branch becomes convinced he has bad luck, and endeavors to reverse his fortunes. It is Branch’s Gem day (an important day during which he will be presented with his unique ‘Gem’), and Poppy wants to make sure everything goes perfectly. Unfortunately, she loses Branch’s gem, and must recruit her friends to help her find it again.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Let's Make A Movie!
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes two little containers of popcorn and two movie tickets, it’s movie night in the dollhouse! Demanding Director CatRat leads the Gabby Cats through a Gabby-fied version of a classic story, Gabby-locks and the Three Bears.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Pete The Polar Bear
programme.desc: Pete the Polar Bear shows up for a vacation on MerCat’s sunny beach. Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats show Pete he can have a great vacation, even if things don’t go precisely to plan.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Salty and Sweet Cruz Blues
programme.desc: Chef J tells Ollie he cooks with love. Kelp and Ollie set out to make food with love for him. When various food combos fail, Ollie considers giving up, because it isn’t good enough. Kelp goes to his Dad for answers, and two seemingly different ingredients form something magical. When Cruz is not his usual upbeat self, Kelp tries various ways to cheer him up before realizing the best way to be a good friend is to just sit with him, and let him feel what he’s feeling.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Pet Sitters Narwhalicorn Day
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop pet-sit Crabby, who acts out until they realize he’s missing home. Kelp feels like he can’t choose between a celebration on land or under the sea. So he attempts to do both... at the same time!

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Welcome to Harmony Harbor
programme.desc: Ari moves in to Harmony Harbor, but notices something strange involving a group of kids, a Noodle Truck chef and her pet squirrel. After Ari discovers the secret of Team Zenko Go, he asks to join the crew. But first he must learn the importance of teamwork.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Delivery Disaster Slippery Business
programme.desc: When Donna's delivery truck breaks down, it's up to the crew to help Donna continue delivering packages to Harmony Harbor's residents. When the crew takes on a mission to rescue a lost pet, Ellie must face her fears in order to help save the day.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Crash Course
programme.desc: Burple and Winger each injure a wing while they're with Dak, and only teamwork can get them home. At the roost, Cutter gets stuck in a puddle of goo.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Furious Fun
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders have a "Dragon Day" to show their skills to a young fan, but Aggro skips it to hang out with her new fun -- but reckless -- friends.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Mouse
programme.desc: Artephius tries to warn the town when an evil mouse charms his way into San Lorenzo - but no one will listen to him.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Goblin
programme.desc: Cleevil, an orphan goblin, seeks refuge in San Lorenzo - but, unbeknownst to Puss, he is in cahoots with the Duchess.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Last Guardian
programme.desc: In order to earn the fire whip, Po and Blade have to get themselves and Rukhmini out of a lost city with no exits, but Rukhimi’s not exactly who she says she is. Our villains’ alliance shatters when Colin realizes the weasels are mages with magical powers, and he leaves Klaus gravely injured.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - A Thread In The Dark
programme.desc: Klaus is injured and Veruca’s mage powers are not working, stifled by her time in prison. They encounter a dangerous village and Veruca reconnects with her abilities in time to save Klaus, but the two are soon captured by Po and Blade, who are unaware of Veruca’s rekindled powers.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Diapers Are The New Black
programme.desc: King Julien discovers diapers and brings style to his lemur subjects, igniting a fashion war.

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP14
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. programme.title: Knot To Treasure - EP5
programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. After their marriage, Yat-sen develops an extramarital affair with Yan (Cui Jiabao), eventually living with her and abandoning Shan. Later, realizing Yan's overly open attitude towards relationships, he decides to pursue Shan again.

programme.title: Shadow Of Justice - EP19
programme.desc: Because of some transfer arrangement and several complicated cases, AICIP Au Yeung Chung (Bobby Au Yeung) and CUSP Tsui Hay-yi (Joey Meng) become collaborating partners. The duo have mutual understanding. Sheung Siu (Jeannie Chan), daughter of a logistics company boss, hates Au Yeung Chung as she is certain that he has caused her family to break up. Au Yeung Chung had promised the late Mrs. Sheung he would be tolerant of Sheung Siu.
